'''Shadda''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] located in the [[Bi-Boran Cluster]]. Eons before [[43 ABY]],<ref name="atlas" /> Shadda expanded into a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]], releasing gases that created the [[Shadda Nebula/Legends|Shadda Nebula]]. It then began cooling into a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] during a long drawn out explosion. As the star faded, so did the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran (species)|natives]] of [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]]. Without the life-giving radiation of their star, the [[Species/Legends|species]], despite the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran exodus|efforts]] of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]], dwindled into extinction.<ref name="atlas" />
